main_text.p: AD VIM FACIENDAM AVT ARCENDAM, SVB CER-TA LEGE. Quinque in definitionem istam partes in-Partes eius.clusi, DILECTVM, ORDINEM, ARMA, ACIEM, DISCIPLINAM: quas singulas ordine, & totidem Sermonibus, educam: Polybij ipsa verba secundùm has partes aptabo, ubi ea quidem erunt: quà deficient, velut laciniam huic vesti à me aut ab aliis adtexam. Omnia deinde explanabo & illustrabo, sed breuiter: quia iamdiu nobis illud sedit, Οὐ τὸ μέγα δῦ[?], ἀλλὰ τὸ εὖ μέγα: Non quod magnum, bonum; sed quod bonum, magnum. Ita olim Demosthenes, valdè pro meo sensu. Sed Polybium ipsum iam audiamus, qui sic de Dilectu. Vin' tu legere? cape. AVD. Et utraque manu quidem: sed Graecis adscripta quae haec versio? LIPS. Nostra est, nam etsi IanusCausa versionis nostrae. Lascaris, homo Graecus, aptè & doctè pleraque iam verterat: tamen reuera alibi aliter, & quod caput est, nonEt qualis ea. semper presse & adstricte. Id autem adprimè mihi placet in scriptoribus qui stilo tales, maximè cùm de re agitur: in quà verbum additum, aut omissum, aut laxius etiam redditum, magnas facit vel mutationes vel erra-tiones. At tu lege.

Ἐπεὶ δ' ἂν ἀποδείξωσι σὺν ὑπάτως[?], μὴ ταῦτα χιλιάρχους καθίσαι, τέσσαρας καὶ δέκα μὲν ἐκ τῶν πέντε ἐνιαυ-σίας ἐχόντων στρατείας, δέκα δ' ἄλλας ὥσπερ τούτοις ἐκ τῶν δέκα τῶν λοιπῶν, σὺν μὲν ἱππεῖς δέκα, σὺν ἢ πεζοὺς εἴκοσι[?] στρατείας τελεῖν κατ' ἀνά-

POLYB.Cùm vero Consules defi-gnauerint, tum Tribunosmi-litum constituunt, quattuordecim quidem ex iis qui iam qui-na stipendia annua confece-rint; decem alios praeterea ex iis qui dena. At reliquorum, equites quidem dena, pedites vicena stipendia explere opor-

page.notes: Greek column is hard to read at this scan size; words marked [?] are uncertain, and the accents may not be exact. The first Greek word of the Ἐπεὶ line and the second line are uncertain. The phrase "Οὐ τὸ μέγα δῦ" is uncertain; the printed Greek may differ. "Tribunosmilitum" is printed with the words run together, as in the original. The speaker labels AVD. and LIPS. are kept as printed. The catchword "tet" is at the foot right, so the paragraph ends on "opor-". The show-through and the neighbouring page edge at the left are left out.
